start_profile: start the vLLM profiler via the /start_profile API endpoint to begin profiling
stop_profile: stop the vLLM profiler via the /stop_profile API endpoint to end profiling
attach_router: attach the profiler router to a FastAPI app when profiler_config is enabled
engine_client: retrieve the EngineClient from a FastAPI request object's app state
build_profiler_api: build a FastAPI router with /start_profile and /stop_profile endpoints for vLLM profiling
